title: Tech Teardown 1
description: Learn the tools and gestures of the cyberpunk- bring your own tools and devices, or don't! We have plenty. Come take stuff apart and don't worry aboout putting it back together.

title: FDN 11010 Intro to Hacking
description: Welcome, students, to your first [VARIABLE UNDEFINED] class. Here we will be having fun, sharing in the tradition of phreaks and g33ks the whole world over, pooling knowledge and learning how to reach into the nether world of software with a pair of boltcutters in hand. Come have fun with us! Today's subjects of study: breaking AI models, fake IDs in cyberspace, and beginner hardware hacking

title: Community FIXIT Forum
description: Join me and friends as we gather to create a no-judgement environment where you can come to learn how to fix things. Bring your broken shit and we'll see if we can't fix it together. Bring buddies and hang out but with screwdrivers and spitting in the face of consumerism also!
